# Personal mathematics and Lean workbench

Your PAL-related research stays together here. Open a named paper folder for its sources, checked claims, and proof links. The shared Lean project preserves the original collection; APCI and the newly audited FRONT companion have dedicated projects inside their paper folders.

## Main papers

| Paper | Receipt coverage |
| --- | --- |
| [FRONT](<FRONT/README.md>) | v1.0 six-batch local audit complete: 17 general mathematical targets, four bounded formalizations, all 13 module kernel checks passed; two fresh correction replays. [Receipt book](<FRONT/Lean project/Audit/RECEIPT_BOOK.md>). |
| [PAL](<PAL/README.md>) | Existing bounded Lean receipts across v2.0, v2.1, v2.3, and the v2.4 candidate. |
| [CHARTER](<CHARTER/README.md>) | 15 original CHARTER targets and 4 follow-up targets in shared execution receipts. |
| [BRIDGE](<BRIDGE/README.md>) | Endpoint, four-sector, diagram/readout, dimension/recovery, and generated-range receipts retained. |
| [GOLD](<GOLD/README.md>) | Source collected; no GOLD-specific Lean receipt identified in this collection yet. |
| [RPL](<RPL/README.md>) | v1.0 manuscript and supporting evidence package collected; not independently replayed in this organization step. |
| [MIND](<MIND/README.md>) | 35 declarations in the retained reduced MIND-inspired continuation experiment. |

## Other mathematics

- [Abstract Loops](<Other mathematics/Abstract Loops/README.md>) — Three workshop batches completed with local kernel receipts, plus the preserved C1/C5 evidence. Finite-image stabilization now covers arbitrary alternatives.
- [APCI](<Other mathematics/APCI/README.md>) — Existing audit retrieved; all 15 declarations locally replayed with matching dependencies and a passing bundled kernel check.
- [Compactification Costs](<Other mathematics/Compactification Costs/README.md>) — Three batches complete: boundary topology, typed profiles, and selected geometric fixtures.
- [Finite Abstraction](<Other mathematics/Finite Abstraction/README.md>) — Selected coverage and quantifier controls complete; no RH or P-versus-NP result claimed.
- [GPPR](<Other mathematics/GPPR/README.md>) — Three batches complete with an explicit external transcendence dependency; exact encoding and routing controls checked.
- [Single Cut Transport](<Other mathematics/Single Cut Transport/README.md>) — Three batches complete: finite span, corridor invariance and the full seven-column OR gadget.

## Shared machinery and preserved history

- [Complete receipt catalog](<Shared Lean project/workbench/CATALOG.md>)
- [How to replay the checks](<Shared Lean project/workbench/REPLAY.md>)
- [Original migration record](<Shared Lean project/workbench/migration/2026-10-07/completion.json>)
- [Folder reorganization record](<Shared Lean project/workbench/layout-20261008/move-receipt.json>)

The shared project moved intact: proof names, imports, Git history, old result labels, and receipt files retain their original identities. Paper folders link to the actual Lean files. FRONT's separately authorized companion reuses byte-pinned APCI/BRIDGE modules with explicit provenance; the original shared sources remain intact.

The Math Stack originals remain unchanged. Sources here are hash-checked copies. The old C: checkout remains the recovery copy. FRONT remains unpublished; its new claim map identifies exactly which inherited APCI/BRIDGE statements support its coverage.

## Audit queue

APCI's existing 15-declaration audit is now recovered and locally replayed.

Chris activated the Abstract Loops portion of the [five-paper workshop key](<Shared Lean project/workbench/keys/20261008-five-paper-audit/WORKFLOW_KEY.md>) on 8 October 2026. **Its three batches are complete**; the [new receipt book](<Shared Lean project/Audit/abstract-loops-20261008/RECEIPT_BOOK.md>) records the results. Chris then activated the remaining ten batches, which are now complete locally. The [combined receipt book](<Shared Lean project/Audit/workshop-rest-20261008/RECEIPT_BOOK.md>) records all four papers, the explicit golden-transcendence dependency and the G06 root qualification. The original key and its source map are retained as preparation history.

FRONT's own later key was activated and completed locally on 8 October; its four remaining formalization bridges and independent-review lane are recorded in its receipt book. GOLD's full audit, RPL, and recovery of CHARTER's earlier chains remain on the broader queue. Reuse a prior receipt only after its source and formal statement match.

[Earlier organization and reading checkpoint](<Shared Lean project/workbench/layout-20261008/audit-queue.md>) · [Current key source map](<Shared Lean project/workbench/keys/20261008-five-paper-audit/SOURCE_MAP.json>)
